newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev eases on forex buying from importers.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev eases on forex buying from importers.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev eased to 995-996 per mark at the close from the opening's 994.50-995.50, due to increased foreign currency demand from fuel and energy importers, traders said.
* The lev closed at 1,828-1,831 per dollar, down from 1,815-1,818 in the morning following mark/dollar losses on global markets.
* The lev was pegged at 1,000 per mark as anchor currency in an IMF-prescribed fixed exchange rate mechanism, the currency board, introduced on July 1 to restore confidence in the lev.

* Domestic interbank lev/mark trade has been calm and range-bound near central bank's fixed mark bid of 995 levs since the start of the currency board regime due to seasonally low foreign currency demand from large end clients.
* The lev/dollar eased to its current levels from around 1,730 on July 1 in line with the mark/dollar retreat on international markets.

* Under the currency board system, Bulgaria's central bank pledged to buy and sell unlimited volumes of marks, the anchor currency, at a bid of 995 levs and ask of 1,000. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
